news.title: Musk, Uber co-founder join call for Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia
news.summary: Tech tycoon Elon Musk and an Uber co-founder are, as of Sunday, among more than 158,000 signatories of an open letter calling for Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia chief.In Washington, however, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent argued Sunday that Nvidia should look "outside" the company for its next chief.

analysis.summary: Tech leaders including Elon Musk signed an open letter seeking Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO, while US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urged Nvidia to hire an outsider.
analysis.rationale: Strong tech-industry backing for Huang's return is offset by senior US government opposition, creating conflicting governance pressures on NVDA.
